Shoga awakens abruptly with a start.  Staring around she re-orients herself to her surroundings.  Shaking her head to clear what remains of sleep she moves slowly when suddenly overtaken by visions.

The events from the previous night replay in her head, but flashes of the past showing the Pharoh, alive with retinue are also glimpsed.  A strange woman appears calling soundlessly.  Shoga being used to these visions is not unduly concerned but she is unsettled just the same.  She sees past glories, treasures, relics, people juxtaposed with the known events of last night.  All blending together in a confusing maelstrom of sensory overload.  Groaning, Shoga tightly shuts her eyes trying to calm herself and stopping the vision.  After a few minutes, what seems like an eternity to her, it all stops, just as abruptoly as it started.   Sighing, Shoga continues her morning routine.  Once she has regained her composure and does her morning abolutions she decides to go outside along the river and watch the sunrise to wait the day.  She knows she will eat, she knows she will work in Jack's shop, and she knows there are others that may need her.  The latter brings a slight smile.  It has not been often that she has ever considered herself needed by anyone else, but herself.
Shoga makes her way out of the inn to <#636016053109129261> to watch the dawn and contemplate many things.
Que orchestra.

Shoga leaving the <#636015050829856768>  follows the road and goes to sit by the river.  Finding a spot she simply sits and thinks on the previous days events, and the future.  Asking what will come?  What has been?  What is the reason? and many others.
